title.narrative: Multi-sectoral Intervention Improving Health Conditions in Ethiopia

description.narrative: The proposed multi-sectoral intervention is aimed at improving health conditions in the woredas of Chifra and Hamer in the Afar and SNNP regions. The project will focus on achieving health milestones through the rehabilitation of the health facilities in both regions and nutrition in education by constructing and rehabilitating the targeted schools. To ensure a holistic approach to the intervention, integration of WaSH, energy and biofuel will be weaved into the different components of the project. In strengthening the milestones of the health sector and ensuring progress in achieving universal healthcare, the project will provide technical assistance to the Ministry of Health by enhancing its capacity to provide strategic direction, leadership and coordination of stakeholders to achieve the health transformation plan.
